summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a transaction agreement with Amazon.com Inc. and issuance of warrants to Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC. The warrants can purchase up to 13,880,345 common shares at US$8.56 per share over ten years, with 5,545,880 vested immediately. Vesting of remainder ties to incremental purchases up to US$280 million. This is a commercial partnership warrant issuance, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report of a commercial agreement with strategic investor warrants.
